resources.string: An RWKV model reads your review history and predicts how likely you are to recall each review card right now. A card comes due when that chance falls to its deck’s desired retention, and the cards you are most likely to have forgotten come first. New and learning cards are scheduled as usual. Anki’s stored due dates are never changed, so turning this off brings back your usual schedule at once.
Choose the day’s reviews once, at your first study. Cards you finish don’t come back until tomorrow.

The most accurate. An 11 MB download, about 26 KB of memory per card (about 9 times Small), and about 4 times slower than Small to read your review history.
The default. A 430 KB download and about 3 KB of memory per card.
A 240 KB download that reads your review history about 1.6 times faster than Small, with about the same memory per card.
Choosing another model downloads it if needed and reads your review history again. Until then, reviews use your usual schedule. The choice syncs with your collection.
